Notes on sports club Example Answer Name of club Kingswell

transcript.en: Good morning, oh sorry, it's gone 12, I'll start again, good afternoon, Kingswell Sports Club, how can I help you?
transcript.zh: 早上好，对不起，都过了12点了。我重来一遍

transcript.en: Oh, good afternoon. I was wondering if you could give me some information about membership and facilities.
transcript.zh: 下午好，我在想你能不能向我介绍一下那里的会员资格和设施。

transcript.en: Of course. What would you like to know?
transcript.zh: 没问题，你想了解什么

transcript.en: Do you have tennis courts, for example?
transcript.zh: 比如，你那里有网球场吗？

transcript.en: No, I'm afraid we don't. We're primarily a golf club.
transcript.zh: 恐怕我们没有，我们主要是一个高尔夫球俱乐部。

transcript.en: What about football? I heard you had a team.
transcript.zh: 足球呢？我听说你们有一个球队。

transcript.en: No, I'm sorry. Perhaps you're thinking about Fresham Sports Centre.
transcript.zh: 哦，不对 你说的是Freshham运动中心吗

transcript.en: Oh, right. I know it. I've played badminton there.
transcript.zh: 是的 我知道那里，我在那里打过羽毛球

transcript.en: Have you?
transcript.zh: 是吗

transcript.en: They've got a lot of facilities we don't have and vice versa.
transcript.zh: 他们有很多我们没有的设施，反之也是一样。

transcript.en: We do have a keep-fit studio, which is very popular with members, and then as well as that there's swimming, of course.
transcript.zh: 我们有一个很受欢迎的健身房，在那里还可以游泳。

transcript.en: That's good. I like to swim every day.
transcript.zh: 不错 我喜欢天天游泳

transcript.en: We have a range of classes too.
transcript.zh: 我们还有一系列的课程。

transcript.en: Do you have judo classes? I'm keen to learn.
transcript.zh: 你们有柔道课程吗？我很想学。

transcript.en: Well, at the moment we offer kick-boxing. We're planning to add judo and stretch classes soon.
transcript.zh: 现在我们有拳击 很快会有柔道和伸展

transcript.en: We're currently running a range of yoga classes, too.
transcript.zh: 我们目前也开设了一系列瑜伽课。

transcript.en: What about relaxing after exercise? I assume you have a restaurant or something.
transcript.zh: 运动后的休息呢？我想你们有餐馆或者别的设施？

transcript.en: At the moment, we've got a salad bar which is very popular. We'll also have a fully-licensed restaurant by the end of the year.
transcript.zh: 现在，我们有一个很受欢迎的沙拉吧。今年年底，我们还会有一个经营项目齐全的餐馆。

transcript.en: Sounds good!
transcript.zh: 不错

transcript.en: What kind of membership are you interested in?
transcript.zh: 你想办理成为哪种会员。

transcript.en: Um, not really sure.What are the options?
transcript.zh: 不是特别确定 都有什么选择？

transcript.en: Well, there are three different membership schemes.
transcript.zh: 有三种不同的会员制。

transcript.en: I see. What's the difference?
transcript.zh: 懂了，有什么区别吗

transcript.en: Well, the first one's called Gold, and you can use all the facilities at any time of the day or week.
transcript.zh: 首先是金牌会员，你可以在一天或一周的任何时间使用所有设施。

transcript.en: You can also join in as many classes as you like for free.
transcript.zh: 你可以免费加入你喜欢的很多课程。

transcript.en: That sounds good. Is it very expensive?
transcript.zh: 听起来不错，贵吗?

transcript.en: Well, you pay a ￡250 joining fee and then it's ￡450 - oh no, I'm sorry, it's just gone up by ￡50, sorry about that - it's now ￡500 for the annual subscription fee.
transcript.zh: 你要交纳250英镑的会费，然后是450英镑……不，对不起，涨了50英镑。对不起，现在的年费是500英镑

transcript.en: Right, got that. And what's the next type?
transcript.zh: 懂了 下一步呢

transcript.en: Well, that's Silver - it's the same as Gold except you have to pay a small fee of ￡1.00 per lesson for any you do and you can only use the centre at certain times.
transcript.zh: 是银牌会员，它和金牌一样，只是你要花一点钱，你上的每节课要花一英镑而且你只能在特定的时间使用中心的设施。

transcript.en: I see. So when exactly?
transcript.zh: 懂了，具体什么时候

transcript.en: You can only use the facilities between 10 am and 4.30 pm.
transcript.zh: 你只能在上午10点到下午4:30之间使用这里的设施。

transcript.en: So I couldn't use the pool at 8 in the morning or evening, then?
transcript.zh: 所以我不能在早上8点或晚上使用游泳池了？

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: OK. And the price for that?
transcript.zh: 好的，价格呢？

transcript.en: Is the joining fee the same as for Gold?
transcript.zh: 会费和金牌会员一样吗？

transcript.en: Actually, it's slightly less than the ￡250 - it's ￡225, but the annual fee is only ￡300.
transcript.zh: 事实上，比250英镑少点，是225英镑。但是年费只有300英镑。

transcript.en: Does that sound more like what you want?
transcript.zh: 这是你想要的吗？

transcript.en: Well, it's still rather more expensive than I thought. I'm a student here in England and I'm only here for six months.
transcript.zh: 这还是比我想的价格高。我在英格兰只是学生，而且我在这里只待6个月。

transcript.en: Ah, then the Bronze scheme would probably suit you best.
transcript.zh: 那么，铜牌会员制可能更适合你。

transcript.en: How is that different?
transcript.zh: 这有什么不同？

transcript.en: Well, some of the facilities have restricted use.
transcript.zh: 一些设施被限制使用

transcript.en: And do I have to pay for classes?
transcript.zh: 我上课需要交钱吗？

transcript.en: Yes, it's ￡3 for each class you join.
transcript.zh: 3磅一节

transcript.en: I see. And what are the hours then?
transcript.zh: 懂了。时间呢？

transcript.en: Between 10.30 and 3.30 weekdays only and you pay a ￡50 joining fee.
transcript.zh: 只能在工作日的10:30到3:30，会费是50英镑。

transcript.en: The annual fee is ￡180 - it works out at ￡15 a month, so that would be quite a lot cheaper.
transcript.zh: 年费是180英镑，一个月15英镑，这个很便宜。

transcript.en: Oh, that should be all right. I could come in my free periods. What do I have to do if I want to join?
transcript.zh: 这个可以 我有空的时候就去。如果我想加入，我还要做些什么？

transcript.en: Well, we book you in for an assessment with an instructor, who will show you how to use all the equipment.
transcript.zh: 我们为你预定一个教练进行评估，他会告诉你如何使用这些设备。

transcript.en: If you want to organise a trial session and look around the centre, you'll need to speak to David Kynchley.
transcript.zh: 如果你想上试听课并参观一下中心，你需要找大卫·芬奇利。

transcript.en: Hmm. Could you spell that please?
transcript.zh: 拼一下？

transcript.en: Yes, David K-Y-N-C-H-L-E-Y.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: I'll give you his direct line number.
transcript.zh: 我给你他的直线电话。

transcript.en: It's O—four—five—eight—nine—five—three—double one.
Thanks.
transcript.zh: 谢谢

transcript.en: Thank you for calling Kingswell Sports Club.
transcript.zh: 谢谢你拨打金斯韦尔健身房。
